host_changes: Explicit FP32/FP64 rank-one raw input and Bool output contract
Exact byte-footprint disjointness guard, allowing disjoint views of the same allocation
Empty return of original out0 without device setup or launch
Direct pointer slices; no clone, copyback, reshape, scratch, or normalization
Chunks of at most 2^30 elements and fixed 1024-lane grids
Signed int64 index and stride address multiplication before typed-width scaling
source_changes: Replace generated block-pointer/capped-loop writer with direct masked flat strided writer
Preserve the original scalar helper and both explicit precision branches
raw_api: Original StridedBuffer supports shape/stride/dtype/data_ptr reinterpretation; base dtype and lazy metadata flags are retained
tensor_flags: Standard Tensor operands reject lazy-negative metadata; raw StridedBuffer semantics do not interpret that flag
allocation: No new allocation; exact original output object returned
cpu_scalar_adapter: numpy.isfinite replaces only the unsupported CUDA libdevice externs during actual Triton CPU interpretation
proof_scope: Kernel execution, all-word FP32/FP64 classification, active-lane results and exterior memory frame; host proofs optional
primitive_model_boundaries: CUDA finitef/isfinited denote all-word exponent-field finiteness classification at the selected precision
Same-precision casts and typed loads preserve their scalar value
Native byte-address/load/store ABI, metadata observation and absence of concurrent external mutation
candidate_change: Commute only pid * BLOCK_SIZE to BLOCK_SIZE * pid; no floating numerical transformation
